versions.statuteQuote: Agrees to the payment of a security deposit, insurance premiums for damage insurance, and insurance premiums for renter's insurance prior to the commencement of the tenancy that exceed the amount of two months' periodic rent

summaryForModel: The security deposit, damage insurance premiums, and renter's insurance premiums paid before the tenancy starts cannot together exceed two months' rent.
paraphraseExamples: Tenant shall pay a security deposit of $2,800 and a damage waiver premium of $300 prior to move-in.
Resident must purchase the community's renter's insurance and prepay the annual premium at lease signing, in addition to a two-month deposit.
tenantExplanation: Virginia caps what you pay up front for the deposit plus damage and renter's insurance at two months' rent combined.
action: You can ask your landlord to lower the deposit or insurance charges so the total is two months' rent or less.
